run_collision_detection: run the full collision detection pipeline with broadphase and narrowphase stages on a MuJoCo model and data
run_sweep_and_prune_broadphase: run sweep-and-prune broadphase collision detection to identify potential geometry pairs efficiently
run_nxn_broadphase: run brute-force N-squared broadphase collision detection on pre-filtered geometry pairs
run_narrowphase: run narrowphase collision detection for convex and primitive geometry pairs to compute contact details
create_collision_context: create a collision context with a maximum contact count for storing collision pair results
